# Block solution of the transportable 11-symbol selection: the 504 loops of the (7, 3) block.
# K = 10 letters: old letters 0 .. 6 in the cyclic order 0123456, added letters 7, 8, 9; distinguished letter A.
# One line per 2-loop: x v.  x = the state at which the row starts (row = the slice chosen from the 2-loop),
# v = number of cyclic classes of the row: 10 full, 8 short, other numbers = rows of other visible lengths,
# 0 = loop without a row (x is then the rotation that starts with 0).  F, S, D stand for 10, 8, 0.
# Full and short rows only: 287 full, 91 short (Q = 182), 126 loops without a row; three closed walks of
# 182, 133 and 63 rows with one closed trail each.  Q + D = 308, floor Q + D + trails = 311.
# 308 is the optimum of Q + D among full / short solutions invariant under rotation of the old letters
# (python block_grb.py 7 3 --sym old --maxd 2 --slack 0); this file is one of the optimal solutions.
